items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 16 at 2:43AM EDT until October 20 at 3:00AM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 knots with gusts up to 35 knots
and seas 6 to 13 feet expected.

* WHERE...Portions of Gulf of America.

* WHEN...From 5 PM Saturday to 3 AM EDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
